blanks.note: State Bank of Pakistan Annual Financial Statements for the year ended 30 June 2022 (https://www.sbp.org.pk/assets/document/publications/AFS-2022-eng_1.pdf), note 8.3 on foreign currency assets, read through WebFetch after the host returned HTTP 403 to curl. The note confirms outside management but names nobody: balances are 'maintained, on behalf of the Bank through reputable fund managers' and 'The activities of these fund managers are being monitored through a custodian', with market value of Rs 426,417 million (about USD 2,081.3 million) at 30 June 2022. No firm, no World Bank/RAMP, no BIS anywhere in the note. A naming source for Pakistan would have to be a procurement or mandate document, not the statements.

Banco Central de Nicaragua audited financial statements 2024 and 2023/2022, plus Informe BCN 2025, all downloaded and grepped in full (Informe de Estados Financieros BCN 2024 FINAL.pdf; Estados financieros auditados 2023 y 2022.pdf; Informe_BCN_2025_Final.pdf, bcn.gob.ni). Note 4 'Depositos en el exterior' and note 5 'Inversiones en el exterior' are pure counterparty tables — Bank for International Settlements, Bank of America, Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Deutsche Bundesbank Zentrale, Banco Centroamericano de Integracion Economica, split into overnight/short/medium term with rates of 0.10-4.53%. Grep for administrador/administradores externos/delegad/World Bank/Banco Mundial/RAMP/BIRF and the firm word list returned nothing in any of the three documents. The only hits for 'externos' are 'pasivos externos a largo plazo'.

leads_not_opened.lead: Seychelles-style reserves-management reports tabled in parliament: nationalassembly.sc works under plain curl where central bank sites do not. For this assignment the equivalent hosts to try are the Legislative Assembly of Tonga (TON), the Transitional National Legislative Assembly of South Sudan (SSD) and the Parliament of Bangladesh (BGD).

Hosts that block curl but may serve WebFetch, each with an exact URL already in hand: centralbankbahamas.com (BHS, 2022 Annual Report and FS), nbrm.mk (MKD, Annual_Report_2024-NB.pdf, needs offset 100000+), portalunico.iaip.gob.hn (HND, ver_archivo ids), sbp.org.pk (PAK, worked through WebFetch).
bcrp.gob.pe (PER) is behind Incapsula for both curl and WebFetch — needs a third route or a mirror of the monthly English 'international reserves' report.
